mapper.sql: recipient_id = #{user} and channel = #{channel} and active = 1 and id = #{id}
mapper.select: select e.id, e.channel, e.target_type as targetType, e.target_id as targetId, if(e.channel = 'interaction', e.source_id, null) as commentId, e.is_read as isRead, e.create_time as publishTime, concat(coalesce(u.nickname, '博客用户'), case e.event_type when 'reply' then '回复了你的评论' when 'comment' then '评论了你的文章' when 'follow' then '关注了你' else '赞了你的内容' end) as title, case when e.channel = 'interaction' and c.id is not null and a.id is not null then c.content else '' end as content, case e.target_type when 'article' then a.id is not null and (e.channel != 'interaction' or c.id is not null) when 'say' then s.id is not null when 'treehole' then t.id is not null else u.id is not null end as sourceAvailable from (select * from b_inbox_event where ) e left join b_user u on u.id = e.actor_id and u.user_status = 0 left join b_article a on e.target_type = 'article' and a.id = e.target_id and a.deleted = 0 and a.status = 2 and coalesce(a.read_auth,1) = 1 left join b_comment c on e.channel = 'interaction' and c.id = e.source_id and c.article_id = e.target_id and c.deleted = 0 and c.status = 1 left join b_say s on e.target_type = 'say' and s.id = e.target_id and s.deleted = 0 and s.status in (0,1) left join b_treehole t on e.target_type = 'treehole' and t.id = e.target_id and t.deleted = 0 and t.status in (0,1) order by e.create_time desc, e.id desc
select count(*) from b_inbox_event where recipient_id = #{user} and active = 1 and is_read = 0
mapper.update: update b_inbox_event set is_read = 1 where and is_read = 0
mapper.insert: insert into b_inbox_event (recipient_id, actor_id, channel, event_type, target_type, target_id, source_id) select distinct r.recipient, c.user_id, 'interaction', if(r.recipient = p.user_id, 'reply','comment'), 'article', a.id, c.id from b_comment c join b_article a on a.id = c.article_id and a.deleted = 0 and a.status = 2 and coalesce(a.read_auth,1) = 1 left join b_comment p on p.id = c.parent_comment_id and p.article_id = a.id and p.deleted = 0 and p.status = 1 and coalesce(nullif(p.source,''),'article') = 'article' join lateral (select a.user_id as recipient union select p.user_id) r on true where c.id = #{id} and c.deleted = 0 and c.status = 1 and coalesce(nullif(c.source,''),'article') = 'article' and r.recipient != c.user_id on duplicate key update id = b_inbox_event.id

choose.when: select user_id from b_article where id = #{target} and deleted = 0 and status = 2 and coalesce(read_auth,1) = 1
select user_id from b_say where id = #{target} and deleted = 0 and status in (0,1)
choose.otherwise: select user_id from b_treehole where id = #{target} and deleted = 0 and status in (0,1)

mapper.insert: insert into b_inbox_event (recipient_id, actor_id, channel, event_type, target_type, target_id, source_id) values (#{user}, #{actor}, #{channel}, #{channel}, #{type}, #{target}, #{target}) on duplicate key update is_read = if(active = 0,0,is_read), create_time = if(active = 0,now(3),create_time), active = 1
mapper.update: update b_inbox_event set active = 0 where actor_id = #{actor} and channel = #{channel} and target_type = #{type} and target_id = #{target} and active = 1
mapper.select: select distinct recipient_id from b_inbox_event where channel = #{channel} and target_type = #{type} and source_id = #{source}
